title: vcache vmods/<id>.yml
description: One selected VMOD. Authority is 'python3 tools/matrix.py validate'; this schema is editor assistance only (DESIGN.md decision 11).

id.description: VMOD id. Must equal the filename stem — the validator checks that; this schema cannot.

homepage.description: Project page, used in the package metadata.

sources.description: How this VMOD's source ref is chosen per engine.

head.description: Branch used for the trunk lane's moving target.

default.description: The ref/version used for any engine without a by_series override.

ref.description: Git ref to build: a tag, branch, or commit. This is the pin.

version.description: Upstream version for package naming, quoted so it stays a string (e.g. "1.7", not 1.7).

by_series.description: Per-engine-series overrides, keyed by an engine's 'series' value. The validator additionally checks each key names a series some engine declares; this schema only checks shape.

ref.description: Git ref to build: a tag, branch, or commit. This is the pin.

version.description: Upstream version for package naming, quoted so it stays a string (e.g. "1.7", not 1.7).

package.description: What the generated .deb/.rpm says about itself.

summary.description: One-line package summary (Debian Description / RPM Summary).

description.description: Long description as a list of plain lines, one per line of prose. No '|' block scalars: the parser rejects them.

build_deps.description: Extra build dependencies, per packaging ecosystem.

debian.description: Extra Build-Depends beyond the common set.

rpm.description: Extra BuildRequires beyond the common set.

items.description: A VCL import name: lowercase, digits and underscores.

modules.description: VCL import names this VMOD ships. Defaults to [<id>]; required when the id is not a legal module name (e.g. varnish-modules).

items.description: An engine family, as engines.yml 'family' spells it.

families.description: Engine families this VMOD's build system supports. Gates package-mode expansion only; absent means no restriction, and compat cells are unaffected (DESIGN.md decision 13).

tests.description: Opt in to running the VMOD's own suite in compat mode.
